observations: A light-colored (cream or beige) fabric sofa.
The upholstery has a vertical channeled or ribbed design on the seat and backrest.
The sofa appears to be a 2-seater based on its proportions.
The photo is taken from an elevated angle showing the top and front.
There is a watermark 'KENN PETERS' across the center of the image.
The background shows wood-textured wall paneling.

claims.evidence: No measuring tool is visible in the photo to confirm dimensions.
The photo angle and lighting are insufficient to detect small or faint stains.
The photo does not show the back, sides, or underside where tears often occur.
Physical firmness cannot be determined from a static image.

risks.risk: Foam may be collapsed or lost its resilience.
risks.proof: A video of a person sitting on the sofa and standing up to show the foam rebounding.
A photo of the underside of the sofa with the dust cover removed or pulled back.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged or sagging frame

risks.risk: Hidden stains, odors, or pet hair on the fabric.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the seat cushions and armrests in natural light.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the seat and armrests to check for fabric wear and stains.
A video of someone applying pressure to the cushions to check foam firmness.
Photos of the back and sides of the sofa.
A photo of the underside to inspect the frame.
response.reason: The item is clearly a 2-seater sofa. Although the seller's claims of excellent condition are unverified, it can be priced at the worst-case scenario for a used sofa of this type.
